hypothesis: The exact n=12 Comellas-Yebra local optimum is locked by simultaneous activity of three D4 symmetry orbits of critical triangles. Relaxing one orbit creates a structurally derived escape direction into a different basin, and gradual restoration of that orbit may yield a configuration whose true minimum over all 220 triangles strictly exceeds the frozen baseline.
rationale: An independent high-precision reconstruction found exactly 20 minimum triangles in D4 orbits A, B, and C of sizes 4, 8, and 8. The boundary-aware first-order cone has no nonzero feasible ascent direction with all 20 active, while removing each orbit individually produces a positive common ascent margin. This tests that specific geometric locking mechanism rather than repeating generic global DE or fixed-orientation SLSQP.
expected_information_gain: Determine whether the orbit-specific first-order escape cones survive finite nonlinear continuation, whether restoring the omitted orbit changes the active-set combinatorial type, whether any arm reaches a distinct basin, and whether any final all-220 true minimum improves the exact Comellas-Yebra baseline.
method: For each arm A/B/C, use its independently derived boundary-feasible LP direction and a 0.02 coordinate displacement from the exact baseline. Optimize 24 coordinates plus a lower-bound variable z by constrained SLSQP at lambda=[0.00,0.10,0.25,0.50,0.75,0.90,0.97,1.00], warm-starting every stage from the previous optimum. For every non-selected triangle impose s_t*det_t/2 >= z; for selected-orbit triangles impose s_t*det_t/2 >= lambda*z, where s_t is the baseline determinant sign. Thus lambda=0 softens the selected orbit to nonnegative signed area and lambda=1 restores all signed constraints. Run one primary chain and one small deterministic Gaussian-jitter robustness chain per arm. At every stage and at final lambda=1, independently compute the absolute area of all 220 triangles; the final judgment uses no relaxed constraints and no signed-area surrogate.
metric: True minimum area over all 220 triangles at every continuation stage, final active triangle set, continuation lower bound z, and final gap from the exact frozen baseline; float64 search values are exploratory until independently reevaluated.
metric_relation_to_true_objective: The final all-220 absolute minimum is the frozen true objective. The continuation lower bound is a search surrogate used only to create and restore the selected-orbit constraints; it is not a record metric. Any strict final excess requires high-precision, independent determinant evaluation, coordinate-bound checks, stability testing, and exact or certified comparison to the baseline.

configuration.relaxation_formulation: selected orbit lower-bound multiplier lambda; all 220 constraints retained, with selected constraints restored at lambda=1
configuration.robustness: one primary and one deterministic Gaussian-jitter chain per arm; jitter standard deviation 0.10 before infinity normalization and coordinate clipping

kill_condition: Stop this hypothesis family after the declared six chains if all arms return to the Comellas-Yebra basin at lambda=1, no new active-set type appears, or all sensible arms fail the first-order mechanism. Stop any chain early for immediate independent verification if its final all-220 float64 minimum exceeds the exact baseline by at least 1e-8. Do not add hundreds of seeds or tune the same schedule after a negative result.

raw_result.independent_verification_status: all six valid; no strict improvement; every final active set matches the 20-triangle baseline set within 1e-12

baseline_comparison.success_relation: final true minimum over all 220 triangles strictly greater than the exact baseline

previous_best_comparison.heilbronn-slsqp-001: no float64 improvement from 12 fixed-orientation starts
previous_best_comparison.heilbronn-de-global-001: no float64 improvement from three full-coordinate DE runs plus polish
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: structurally motivated continuation; not a repeat of either optimizer family

interpretation: All six structurally initialized continuation chains reached a lower true minimum while an orbit was relaxed, but restoration through lambda=1 returned every arm to the Comellas-Yebra basin within float64 noise. Independent 110-digit Decimal evaluation of all 220 triangles found no strict improvement and confirmed the same 20-triangle active set within tolerance. The orbit-specific escape mechanism is rejected at the preregistered budget.
what_was_learned: The first-order escape cones are real at the tangent level: A, B, and C each have positive relaxed margins. They do not survive the declared finite nonlinear continuation; all arms restore the same active-set combinatorial type and finish slightly below the exact baseline because of rounded float64 coordinates.
recommended_next_action: Close this orbit-relaxation hypothesis family, do not create Experiment 73 automatically, and return Heilbronn to director review for a materially different authorized hypothesis if desired.
repetition_justification: This is authorized as one new bounded hypothesis test and is materially different from the prior fixed-orientation SLSQP local multistart and full-coordinate differential-evolution experiments because it uses a first-order orbit-specific escape mechanism and staged constraint restoration.
